summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a strategic collaboration with AWS to drive industrial automation and lower-carbon construction. No special-situation event occurred; the filing describes a cloud/AI partnership and a supply framework agreement for XCarb steel. There are no M&A terms, shareholder impact, or board recommendation. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer regarding operational and commercial agreements, not a special situation.
